review: First twenty-seven spell definitions enumerated with neutral keys, classes, groups, costs, durations and prerequisites. Effects, ambiguous boundaries and catalogue cross-references require executable integration and independent validation.

entries.acceptance: Remove airborne impurities and refresh stale air. One radius-one volume supports one resting person for forty-five minutes without renewal; author scales for exertion and occupants. Partial clearing of lethal vapor can allow remaining vapor to spread, so preserve actual cloud distribution. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Create breathable air in empty space, producing a brief outward breeze where air already exists and bubbles underwater. Fill cavities within solids without bursting them; forbid casting inside living beings. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

spell_data.duration: created air permanent; transient motion five seconds

entries.acceptance: Choose stream origin for range penalty. Stream is one yard wide and extends five yards per effect energy. Each second roll one die per full two energy for knockback only, with no injury. Preserve origin, direction, targets and movement; low-energy flows may have no knockback dice. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

spell_data.maintenance: same as casting energy before skill discount

entries.acceptance: Suppress subject and possessions odor, preventing smell detection without changing other properties or immunity to environmental effects. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Forecast ordinary weather at the chosen place/time, excluding future magical interference. Other planets/planes are ineligible. Treat remote continental multipliers as the specified alternative geographic categories, with author-defined boundaries. energy.formula: two per forecast day; double for outside general area; quadruple for another continent

entries.acceptance: Allow breathing water while retaining ordinary air breathing. Integrate actual immersion, suffocation and expiry without granting underwater movement or pressure immunity. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Grant the air-walking trait effects. Falling breaks the spell; immediate recasting permits one second of fall, about five yards, then an air landing causing one die injury unless a surface is hit first. Resolve the actual turn/height sequence. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Convert earth/stone to air in regular shapes with longest dimension no more than four times shortest. One cubic foot yields one resting-person minute of breathing air. Define fractional volume and transition between listed cost scales explicitly rather than double-charging volume. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Create a dense harmful cloud that flows downhill and disperses by authored wind/terrain. Breathing exposure prompts health once per minute, failure one die injury, and also invokes suffocation. Own cloud movement, dispersal and per-subject exposure clocks. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

spell_data.duration: up to five minutes, reduced by dispersal

entries.acceptance: Use half-damage range fifty yards, maximum one hundred, accuracy three; damage one die minus one burning per invested energy. Metal armor contributes protection one. Injury prompts health at -1 per two injury against stun, with health recovery each turn. Electronics use surge rules; metal obstructions intercept the bolt. Authored conductor effects may interrupt concentration and cause at most one injury, not arbitrary area electrocution. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

spell_data.casting_seconds: one through three seconds of creation/growth

entries.acceptance: Cause -2 dexterity until the subject spends a full turn scratching the chosen spot, longer if armor obstructs access. Only one instance affects the subject. Define scratching action legality and actual access instead of automatic one-turn expiry. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Affect a selected voluntary muscle; hand targeting drops held contents. During gesture-dependent unfinished casting, the victim must pass dexterity or restart. Require will against crying out and dexterity against an authored precarious-position accident; impose -3 dexterity and related skills on next turn. Gesture-dependent casting requires will or restarts. Pain resistance gives +3 to these checks and pain sensitivity gives -4. Do not apply both attribute reduction and an extra duplicate skill penalty. Reduce dexterity and derived skills by one per effect energy; no repeated application to derived targets. Maintenance rounds half original effect cost upward before the skill discount. Reduce movement and dodge each by one per effect energy. Preserve ordinary minimum/legality conventions rather than converting a negative movement value into movement credit. Immobilize feet. Each subject turn permits strength resistance at -5 against the original casting margin. While bound, nonranged weapon skills take -2 and dodge is halved, rounded down. Escape ends the effect without a new caster roll. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Must deliver to a limb; another location does not trigger the intended effect. Ignore armor and resolve resistance on contact. Successful effect temporarily cripples the identified limb. Deliver to a limb, ignore armor and resolve resistance on contact. Success cripples the actual limb and causes one die injury; only magical healing restores the withering. Move earth at movement two and reshape it; stable forms persist, unsupported forms collapse when the spell ends. No direct damage except burial of an immobile victim. A threatened subject gets its next normal turn to escape burial or a created hole; trapped subjects get strength -4 each turn to dig free, potentially worse beyond two cubic yards. Apply breath/suffocation clocks. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Convert earth/clay to ordinary hard stone, never precious gemstones. Resolve host volume/material and resulting structural properties, not a generic item-label replacement. Apply the recorded class rules, learning prerequisites and owned cost/duration lifecycle; definition metadata alone is not executable coverage.

Body spells ordinarily affect living subjects only, with explicit exceptions such as vital-contact. Earth spells ordinarily do not affect stone or metal unless individually stated; earth-seek and stone-to-air explicitly do. Group membership alone must not override per-spell target rules.
